quote: We propose a novel generative pre-trained speech language model GPST that enables controllable, high-quality speech generation in a single stage.
GPST can generate high-quality and semantically coherent speeches in one stage efficiently.

We employ the HuBERT-Large model as the ASR model for English to calculate WER and Wav2Vec2-XLSR-53 for Chinese to calculate CER. We take the publicly available speaker verification model WavLM-TDNN to evaluate the speaker similarity between the prompt and the synthesized speech.
We are interested in the following metrics for speech language models: (1) word error rate (WER), (2) speaker similarity (SPK), and (3) speech quality (DNSMOS).
